successors.text: the Lambayeque region: the Motupe, La Leche, Lambayeque and Zaña valleys

ledger.x: c. 750: the Early Sicán culture begins in Lambayeque. 'The Early Sican period began around 750 and lasted until 900'; the Sicán 'inhabited what is now the north coast of Peru between about 750 and 1375 CE'.

c. 1100: the Late Sicán capital is Túcume. The page says Túcume 'was constructed as the new Late Sican capital' after the Middle Sican centres, burned and abandoned 'between 1050 and 1100', were left; it gives no year. Placed at the start of the Late Sicán period; page…
1375: the Sicán culture ends under Chimú rule.

wars.name: Chimú conquest of Lambayeque
wars.outcome: The Chimú kingdom of Chimor conquers the Lambayeque region circa 1375, ending the Late Sicán period.
